observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
Interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The lid features a circular vent and several circular indentations.
The exterior front has a control panel with a dial and a power indicator light.
The bottom edge of the unit shows significant rust and paint loss.
A manufacturer's specification sticker is visible on the back of the unit.
The compressor and cooling coils are visible at the rear.

risks.risk: The unit may not be cooling or freezing properly.
risks.proof: A photo of frost or ice inside the freezer compartment.

risks.risk: The compressor may be noisy or failing.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with sound.

risks.risk: The rust at the base may be extensive and structurally unsound.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted area.
risks.if_unproven: as having a damaged base requiring repair

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's specification sticker on the back to confirm the model and capacity.
Photo of the interior showing frost or ice to verify the cooling system is working.
Video of the freezer running to check for noise and operation.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Haier Thermocool chest freezer. It can be priced at its worst-case value (not working) until proof of cooling and a clear model number are provided.
